step1_analysis.description: A fully differential folded-cascode amplifier with diode-connected PMOS loads and a complex replica biasing scheme. It is likely used as a low-noise, low-gain pre-amplifier or signal conditioning stage for the calorimetric sensor mentioned in the paper.

paper_reference.title: CMOS Single-Chip Gas Detection System Comprising Capacitive, Calorimetric and Mass-Sensitive Microsensors

sky130_expected.calculation: Av = gm_in / gm_load. Since the PMOS loads (T6, T6P) are diode-connected, the gain is intrinsically low.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 110 dB reported in the paper likely refers to the main OTA of the sigma-delta modulator, not this specific pre-amplifier sub-circuit which has diode-connected loads.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = gm_load / (2 * pi * C_load). With low gain and 1pF load, bandwidth will be high.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Low-gain pre-amplifiers typically exhibit wide bandwidths.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. Assuming ~100uA per branch and 1.8V supply.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply compared to the older 3.5V technology.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure differential DC gain, -3dB bandwidth, transient swing, and power consumption of the pre-amplifier.

X_T2P NET_T4P_S IN_MINUS NET_T1_D VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w='W_p' l='L_p'

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB4 VB4 0 0.54
VVCM VCM 0 0.9
VVB2 VB2 0 0.99
VVB3 VB3 0 0.54
VVB1 VB1 0 0.99

* Common mode and differential inputs
V_IN_CM IN_CM 0 0.9
E_IN_PLUS IN_PLUS IN_CM IN_DIFF 0 0.5
E_IN_MINUS IN_MINUS IN_CM IN_DIFF 0 -0.5
V_IN_DIFF IN_DIFF 0 DC 0 AC 1 SIN(0 0.1 1MEG 0 0)

* Load capacitors
C_L1 OUT_PLUS 0 1p
C_L2 OUT_MINUS 0 1p

.control
  * OP Analysis
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis for Differential Gain
  ac dec 100 1 1G
  let vout_diff = v(OUT_PLUS) - v(OUT_MINUS)
  let gain_mag = mag(vout_diff)
  let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  let gain_3db = dc_gain - 3
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1
  
  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1n 2u
  let vout_diff_tran = v(OUT_PLUS) - v(OUT_MINUS)
  meas tran vout_diff_max max vout_diff_tran
  meas tran vout_diff_min min vout_diff_tran
  
  quit
.endc
.end
